And this year's Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City symposium on monetary policy marks the first under new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, and Fed observers all over the world will be closely watching his Friday speech for signs of how he might further distinguish himself, and the institution, from the Powell era. This meeting at Jackson Hole also comes at a fascinating and tense time for monetary policy in the US and abroad: high bond yields, above-target inflation, and AI's still unrealized effect on broader parts of the economy. We speak with Jeffrey Schmid, the president and CEO of the Kansas City Fed, about what to expect and he also shares his thoughts on the wave of baby boomer retirements and how it’s affecting the labor force, his recent FOMC votes, and he explains why this symposium is so focused on payments.

title_cn: 巴基斯坦表示没有义务接受对伊朗的单方面制裁
summary: Pakistan said it is not “obliged to” comply with unilateral sanctions on Iran unless they are imposed by the United Nations, signaling a willingness to continue trade after the US warned of economic penalties against countries doing business with Tehran.

title: Markets Don't Signal AI Sentiment Shift: Wu Silverman
title_cn: 市场并未发出人工智能情绪转变的信号：Wu Silverman
summary: Amy Wu Silverman, Head of Derivative Strategy at RBC Capital Markets, says the upcoming US midterm elections may be influenced more by anti-AI sentiment than by traditional concerns such as consumer sentiment or rising inflation. She joins Bloomberg's Vonnie Quinn on "Bloomberg Brief."  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fed’s Schmid Talks Policy, Inflation, Credibility, Communication
title_cn: 美联储施密德谈论政策、通胀、信誉和沟通
summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City President Jeff Schmid said monetary policy may be accommodative rather than restrictive, citing underlying demand pressures that could justify a rate hike as soon as September 16. Schmid rejected the idea that the October 28 meeting is off the table due to the midterm election. Speaking with Bloomberg's Michael McKee on the sidelines of the Jackson Hole Economic Symposium, he also addresses the future of the central bank’s communications and meeting schedules. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nepal Floods Test 36-Year-Old PM With Huge Rebuilding Challenge
title_cn: 尼泊尔洪水考验36岁总理重建工作面临巨大挑战
summary: Nepal faces a daunting reconstruction effort after violent flash floods swept away bridges, roads and communications links across the Himalayas, putting Prime Minister Balen Shah’s new government through its first crisis and testing its ability to respond.

title: AI Influencers Are Taking On Brazil’s Election
title_cn: 人工智能影响者正在参与巴西大选
summary: AI-generated personas are appearing in one of the world’s most connected nations.
